title: An Encore for Byomkesh
subtitle: A Stubborn Secret and a Deadly Invention
summary: When an enigmatic inventor refuses to reveal the formula behind his lethal creation, even as a murder conviction looms, Byomkesh Bakshi finds himself drawn into a web of secrets and high-stakes intrigue. As the winter thaws and a new mystery emerges, the famed detective must unravel the truth before more lives are lost. Dive into this gripping tale where science, justice, and stubborn pride collide.
